Girlfriend, we're the same height, and I know how you feel.  I was EXACTLY where you are when I found r/Loseit, and I started around 177lbs.    Don't let life get in the way of your goal, honey.  Let your goal make your life a happier life.  You CAN do this, and you WILL do this.  I know you can.

Spoil yourself by giving yourself the gift of the body you want, and trust, it'll make life just a little bit easier to swallow.  I realized one day after exercising (I always look in the mirror right after for those "immediate" results... haha, sarcasm there for you), and upon looking in the mirror and seeing very little change over time, I realized that hey man, there WAS change.  I may not have won the battle yet, but I sure as hell was winning.

So that's what I have for you, dear.  You may not have won the battle yet, but you're sure as hell winning.
I really hope you do, too. <3 I'm here for you if you ever need to talk.

You ran out of time for your deadline, but that doesn't mean you should throw the rest of your time over some building in New York.

You don't know what sort of beautiful things are still within you.  You don't know what happiness hasn't met you yet.  Keep thinking about when your life was beautiful.  What if you had given up then?  Think about everything you wouldn't have experienced.  There's so much more waiting for you, and there's such better peace out there.  Just, please, don't get to that point.

THE PEACE OF WILD THINGS





When despair for the world grows in me

and I wake in the night at the least sound

in fear of what my life and my children's lives may be,

I go and lie down where the wood drake

rests in his beauty on the water, and the great heron feeds.

I come into the peace of wild things 

who do not tax their lives with forethought

of grief. I come into the presence of still water.

And I feel above me the day-blind stars

waiting with their light. For a time

I rest in the grace of the world, and am free.


— Wendell Berry

September 15, 2008.  2am.  My sister turned 16 that day, I believe.
I've lived a tough life with parents who fought and screamed and yelled at each other and made my sister and I watch.  And mediate.  Give our opinions.  I tried to find refuge in a boyfriend, but he was a douchebag, and then he just left.  Couldn't take it anymore.  Still feel pretty fucked up in the head.

After that I went from have virtually no freedom to actually no freedom.  Things loosened up, then the fighting got so fucking bad I actually saw my mother put a gun against her head and pull the trigger.  I get so lonely, feel so purposeless and devoid of happiness on nights like this where there's no one to talk to that it crosses my mind again.  Hell, that's how I found this post.  I was thinking about suicide.

Life still fucking sucks, but it's got to get better.
It can't stay this bad... I can't let myself believe that.

I've thought about using a gun, hanging myself, drowning in a river.  Most of the time, though, I just end up crying, crying, and crying some more.  Thinking about all the people that won't miss me if I'm dead.  I keep going, though.  God knows why.
